note: Names kept as printed (title-cased from the all-caps print; 'Dr.' kept). School attribution from printed headings: 'Elementary School' / 'Passios Elementary School' = passios; 'Lunenburg Primary School' = primary; 'Middle School' / 'Turkey Hill Middle School' / grades 6-8 = turkey-hill; 'High School' / grades 9-12 = high; Superintendent's office = central-office; K-12, K-5 (where no building is printed), or two buildings = district-wide. Page school primary (Letarte; the page is mostly non-building staff). Bissonnette is a school matron 'Assigned to High School'. Crossing guard is at the Elementary School (passios). Bus section: the printed three-column layout interleaves contractor (caps) and driver lines, so which contractor a driver belongs to is not recoverable here; every bus person is district-wide. People appearing on more than one line (Peterson, Watson, Paton, Einard Warpula, Therese Barney, Sidney Abell, Davis...) are recorded once at the first line printed; role_raw gives the bus/spare label as printed. Lines 36, 37, 43 repeat names already recorded; line 35's 'SEPTEMBER' is a stray word. Line 44 page number. Integration pass, 31 Oct 2026: school bus contractors, drivers and volunteers moved from entries to ignored (not school staff; every 1971-1980 page treated alike), and `middle` written `turkey-hill` -- the 1972 and 1974 listings print the building as `Turkey Hill Middle School (Grades 5-7)`, the town's one middle school.
